Dialogs.Dialog: Hey, since we're here, let's take a photo together.
Anegasaki
A picture？ Sure! Let's take one.
Hey, since we're here, let's take a photo together.
Anegasaki
Go right ahead, any angle's fine. Make sure I look cute, okay？
Hey, since we're here, let's take a photo together.
Anegasaki
Sure, but make it quick, okay？ It's a little embarrassing...
Anegasaki
Get my yukata in the shot too, okay？ I don't get to wear it very often.
Anegasaki
Hey, is my hair messy？ I kind of rushed over here.
Anegasaki
Trick or treat! Or I'll play a trick on you~. Just kidding!▼
Anegasaki
Welcome to the Towano High Cultural Festival!▼ ...How was that？
Anegasaki
When you travel, you just have to do those cutout photo boards, don't you？
Anegasaki
Merry Christmas!▼ Make it a romantic photo, okay？
Anegasaki
Hey, do I look more ladylike than usual？ What do you think？
Anegasaki
Spending my birthday with you... I wonder if my happiness will show right through in the photo？
Anegasaki
Every time I look at this photo, I bet I'll remember how happy I feel right now...
Anegasaki
Me surrounded by nature... Does it make for a good picture？
Anegasaki
Wow, so many food stalls! Smells so good...
Is there anywhere you want to stop？
Hmm, let me see... How about that one？▼
Hehe, you can't have a festival without this!
▲メニュー▲, huh？ Looks delicious.
It really is! Want a bite？
Then...
See？ Look at your face, you love it, don't you？
Yeah, it's great. Thanks!
Anegasaki
There are so many stalls out. Look!
You're right. Hard to pick just one...
Ah, checking them out already？ Which one should we get？
▲メニュー１▲
▲メニュー２▲
▲メニュー３▲
▲メニュー４▲
▲メニュー５▲
This is the one. The festival classic.
You really love this, huh？ Hehe, look how happy you are.
Want some too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Yeah!▼
Mmm, delicious~! Thanks for sharing.
Anegasaki
I made a lunch box for you. Here!
Awesome, thank you!
I'm glad you're happy! If there's anything you don't like, feel free to leave it, okay？
Anegasaki
Here's your lunch! Savor every bite, okay？
Whoa, this looks amazing! Thanks.
Don't wolf it down! It's not running away, so chew properly and eat slowly, okay？
Anegasaki
I made us lunch! Let's eat together.
Sweet, thank you!
You're welcome. It's packed with nutrition and love, you know？
Anegasaki
Sorry to spring this on you. I just really wanted to give this to you.
This is...
Anegasaki
It's late, but here's your birthday present. I really wanted to give it to you on the day...
Anegasaki
Here's an anniversary present. Even if it's a little late.
Anegasaki
Merry Christmas! Looks like Santa ran a little late this year.
Anegasaki
Here, for Valentine's Day. I wish I could've given it to you on the actual day, though.
Thank you. Then here's something from ●, too...
Anegasaki
Aww, thank you! I'm so happy...
Thanks for coming all this way.
Anegasaki
Yeah. I'm really glad I came to give it to you.
Anegasaki
Well, see you! I just wanted to drop off the gift. Next year, I hope we're together on the day.
● will make sure of it. Thanks for today.
Here, for White Day. Sorry it's late.
Anegasaki
Don't be! Thank you, I'm so happy.
Glad you like it. Sorry about the delay.
It's okay. Let's spend it together next year, all right？
(White Day's already passed, but isn't there something I can still do now...？)
Happy birthday, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Anegasaki
A present？ Aww, thank you!
Sorry... Kind of defeats the point if it's not on the actual day.
That's not true at all. Still, I hope we can spend it together next year.
(Come to think of it, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s birthday already passed... Isn't there anything I can still do...？)
Anegasaki
It was before we started dating, but it's fine, right？ It'd be a shame to miss a couples' event.
Good point. Yeah, thanks.
I guess the next event is White Day next month？ ...Hehe! Well, see you later.
(She still gave me chocolate even though we weren't dating yet... Gotta think of a White Day gift.)
Anegasaki
Next week's our anniversary. Do you remember？
Of course. Is there anything you wanna do or eat？
That wouldn't be any different from our usual dates, though. I wanna do something different.
Something different？
Something anniversary-worthy. It doesn't have to be fancy, just something that feels special.
Something special, huh... How about ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ plans the whole date from start to finish...？
Rejected.
Figures...
Hmm, nothing comes to mind right away. We've got time, so I'll think about it, okay？
(Hmm, I want an anniversary that'll make ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ happy, but...)
Anegasaki
About our anniversary tomorrow— wanna go to the shopping mall？
Sounds good, but why？
I thought we could buy something to remember it by. The two of us.
A keepsake？
Right. Going somewhere or having good food is nice, but nothing really lasts afterwards, right？
Something that lasts, huh... Yeah, that might be nice.
Then it's settled. Think about what you'd like, okay？
What's the point if we don't figure it out together？
Good point. Let's figure it out together tomorrow.
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. Sorry to keep you waiting.
Not at all. ● just got here too.
I'm glad. I've been thinking about what to get ever since yesterday...
Come up with anything good？
Nope, I really wanted to figure it out with you. It was so hard trying not to think about it on the way here, you know？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, did you wait long？ Sorry.
Anegasaki
It's fine, we're still early. So, did you think about what to get on the way？
Aren't we supposed to figure that out together？
That's right. I won't let you get a head start on me!
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. You're early.
I just got here myself. Shall we get going？
I wonder what kind of keepsake we should get. Something to display, or maybe something practical...
Anything's fine. Whatever you'd like, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Something we both like, silly. Hehe, I wonder what it'll be~
Anegasaki
Hey, which shop looks good to you？
Wherever you'd like is fine, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
I'd rather go somewhere you like.
Then on the count of three, let's point to the shop we want to go to.
Okay, sure. Ready, set...
...Geez, weren't you going to point？
You too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Hehe, there's no rush, so let's take our time.
Well, how about this one？
Yeah. Every time I look at it, I bet I'll think of today...
Anegasaki
Then let's just check them all out, one by one!
Wait, all of them？
Stop grumbling. Isn't it fun looking around and saying 'this is nice, that's nice' together？
Well, yeah, I guess so.
...Oh. Look at the cologne by that shopfront. The bottle is so cute~
Weren't we supposed to go in order from the edge？
I never said anything about order, did I？ Come on, stop grumbling and walk.
All riiiight.
Then how about this one？
That looks great. ...Yeah, this'll make a wonderful keepsake.
Anegasaki
Hey, hey, this hat might look good on you. Look!
Hey, haven't you only been looking at stuff for ●？
I can't help it! I keep spotting things I want to buy for you. Oh, that watch over there too...
There's a cosmetics shop next door. Don't you like that stuff, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Don't worry about me, really.
No, it's not fine. ● wants to see ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ smile, too.
You're seeing it already, aren't you？ Just shopping with you is so much fun.
But...
Hehe, you're impossible. All right, shall we check out the shop next door, then？
Yeah.
How about this one, then？
Yeah, let's go with that. We found a great one.
Anegasaki
...Thank you.
For today？ If so, ● should thank you, too...
Not just for today. From the moment we met and started dating, I've been grateful to you. I just wanted to tell you.
I'm so happy you treasure our anniversary like this, too. It's the most precious day in the world to me.
Then thank you from ●, too.
Eh？
Because ● feels the exact same way as ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
...Yeah. Oh gosh, I might start crying...
(I'll cherish how I feel today from here on out...)
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. You know, I'm so glad I met you.
What's this all of a sudden？
Can't I just say it？ Come on, what about you？
Of course. ● is so glad to have met ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, too.
You really mean it, right？ I'm not forcing you to say it, am I？
Of course I mean it. Don't you trust ●？
Even when I know, I still want to be sure. It makes me so happy that such a good boy adores me so much~
'Good boy'...？
You'd better appreciate your luck, too! I'm completely devoted to you, after all.
Believe me, I feel it plenty...
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲。
What？
Just wanted to say it. You know, having you answer like it's the most natural thing... It makes me really happy.
Yeah. What's up？ Did you get lonely？
I'm in the mood to be spoiled right now. I pamper you all the time, so I get a turn once in a while, right？
Does ● really get pampered that much？
Oh, you don't even realize it？ That's what makes you so irresistibly cute, though~
Ugh...
...All joking aside, though. Being this happy right now is all thanks to you. Thank you.
That goes for ●, too. Thank you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Anegasaki
Hey, make sure you look forward to the big event next week, okay？
Big event... Could it be ●'s birthday？
Ding-dong! Keep that day open, okay？ I'm going to celebrate with all my heart.
You're really fired up... Got it, I can't wait.
That said, it's still in the planning stages. Planning special surprises is hard, you know？
Don't go overboard, okay？ Just the thought makes me happy.
Overboard how？
Like spending too much...
No need to worry about that. I know money can't buy love, after all.
(Is that really the issue...？)
Anegasaki
About your birthday party tomorrow...
Birthday party？
Yep？ A birthday party for you. We'll set up flowers, get a cake, and celebrate just the two of us.
A birthday party... Um, where？
At your place, of course.
Eh？
I thought about it, and I figured it'd be nice to just relax together instead of doing anything crazy. I'll even make dinner. How's that sound？
What do I think？ ● would love that, of course.
Hehe, then it's settled. I'll pick up groceries on the way, so you don't have to prepare a thing, okay？
(Having my girlfriend come over and cook dinner for me... That's already special enough.)
Anegasaki
...Phew, I bought way too much. Coming in~
Must've been heavy. Maybe ● should've come along to help.
Today's star just needs to kick back and relax. Well then, I'm taking over the kitchen!
Dinner already？ You just got here, you should rest a bit.
Thanks. But don't worry, I'll take it easy later.
I bought a little bouquet, but where should I put it...？
Wow... You're really spoiling me.
It's your birthday, so of course! All you need to do is feel like a king.
(I really appreciate it, but I still feel bad just sitting here...)
Thanks for waiting! Dinner's ready.
I've been waiting for this!
You must be hungry. There's plenty of seconds, so eat up!
Anegasaki
Coming in~! Shopping took longer than I expected.
Come on in. Want something to drink？
Nope, I've got a hungry boy waiting for me, so I think I'll make dinner first.
'Boy'？ Come on... ●'s turning a year older today, you know.
Aww, talking back？ Hehe, so cute~
I'll have it ready as fast as I can, so be a good boy, okay？
You're totally treating me like a kid...
It's your fault for being so adorable. I'll pour you a drink, so sip on that and behave.
(Say what you will, she's really spoiling me...)
Here you go, all done! Clean your plate, okay？
I've been waiting for this!
Hehe, don't rush so much. The food's not going anywhere, okay？
Anegasaki
I'm home~! Hehe, just kidding.
Haha, welcome back. Want something to drink？
That's my line, silly. What would you like？ I'll get dinner going right away, so drink that while you wait.
I'm fine, I can get it myself.
Nope! I came here today to take care of you, so let me spoil you to my heart's content. Because that's what I want.
Well, if you insist... Could you make some tea？
Right away, Master▼
Dinner's ready~!
I've been waiting for this!
Here you go. If you don't like something, feel free to leave it, okay？
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. I have a present for you.
Huh？ But you've already done so much for me...
Hehe, here you go. Happy birthday.
I feel kind of bad taking this...
Thanks. I'll treasure it.
And thank you, too, for spending today with me.
That's ●'s line. I'm really grateful.
Yeah. I'm glad you like it.
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. Happy birthday.
Eh？
Here's your present. I had such a hard time deciding what to get.
Thanks. I wonder what it is...
This is great. I'll treasure it.
Mhm. Well now, I guess that takes care of everything on my list.
...Are you leaving already？
Don't look so pathetic. I'll stay with you until the very last minute, okay？
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. I've got something good for you.
Something good？
Ta-da! Your birthday present. Happy birthday.
Really？ Awesome!
This is great. Thanks so much.
...Hehe.
Hm？ What？
Seeing you smile just made me so happy. You know, I feel really happy right now.
Yeah... ● do too.
Today was the best birthday ever.
Anegasaki
I'm glad. Next year, and the year after that... I hope we can celebrate like this forever.
...Will you make me dinner next year, too？
If that's what you want, I'd love to. But making you dinner... feels like it'll become second nature before long anyway...
Eh？
No, it's nothing. Just thinking I'd like to come make dinner for you even when it's not your birthday.
You're welcome to do that anytime. Thanks so much for today.
Anegasaki
It took so long to prepare, but the actual day was over in a flash.
Thanks for everything. Today was the best birthday ever.
Really？ Well, if you say so...
Sigh, your next birthday is a whole year away, huh. Thinking up all the plans was so much fun, too.
Haha, there are plenty of other occasions, you know.
Don't go lumping your birthday in with other events. To me, it's the most special occasion there is.
Really？
That's right.
I see. ...Thanks so much for today.
Anegasaki
It's all over now, isn't it...？
I had a great time. Today was the best birthday ever.
I'm glad. Let's celebrate together next year, and the year after that too, okay？
Yeah.
Fufu. ...Hey, I have one last present for you.
Wait, even more...？
Happy birthday. I'm so truly happy you were born.
It's straight from my heart. Please accept it, okay？
...Yeah. Thank you so much for today.
Your birthday is coming up soon, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Anegasaki
Oh, it's still a ways off. That's not till the week after next.
Hm？ Oh, right... Yeah.
I wish I'd been born a month later... or at least after Golden Week, you know？
Huh？ Why is that？
My birthday is April 20th, right？ It's right when the new school year starts and you're barely making friends, so I always missed out on presents.
Plus, everyone only talks about Golden Week around now, so no one cares about my birthday.
Makes sense...
But that's totally fine now. Because now, I have you to celebrate all of it▼
(Talk about pressure...)
About your birthday next week... Is there anywhere you want to go？
Anegasaki
Ooh, you're taking me out？ Anywhere at all？
Yeah. Ah, but maybe not anywhere too intense...
I know, I know. Well... how about an amusement park？
An amusement park？ I'm down, but that's kind of unexpected.
Really？ Because it's my birthday, I want to feel like a kid again. The older you get, the harder that is, don't you think？
I see... Got it, then let's go all out and have a blast on the big day.
Holding hands and skipping along, la-la-la! Fufu.
(Maybe I got here a little too early...)
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲。
You're early, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
I just couldn't sit still at home! Though you really surprised me. I was sure I'd beat you here.
Today of all days, I was determined to get here before you did, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
You're that pumped for today？ That makes me so happy.
Well, it is a special day. Shall we head out？
Yep▼
Oh, right, I have to say this first.
What is it？
Happy birthday, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. I'm really glad we get to celebrate together.
Thank you. ...Jeez, you're coming on strong right away! Trying to make me swoon already？
Haha, then mission accomplished.
All right, let's have some fun!
Whoa, full speed ahead right from the start, huh？
Of course! Make sure you keep up with me till the end, okay？
Anegasaki
...All right, next up is the carousel!
Uhh...
Hey now. Whose celebration is it today, mister？
Okay, okay. I'd be honored to ride it with you, ma'am.
Hehe, that's what I like to hear. Hey, look, there's a white horse for two! I want that one.
Ehhh... Really...？
Aw, look at that face. And here I was really hoping for that one~ Nene is so sad~
Ugh... It would be my absolute honor to ride it!
Yay! You're in front, then. Come on, hurry, hurry!
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is so excited, just like a little kid. I'm glad we came.)
Anegasaki
You know... truth is, a tiny part of me kind of wished my birthday wouldn't come.
Huh, why do you say that？
Because it just reminds me that I'm older. I'll graduate before you, and become an adult first.
It's not like I dwell on it all the time, you know？ I just wish I could have done it all with you.
It's not like ● hasn't felt that way sometimes too, but...
...Yeah.
All the more reason to make lots of time to be together like this.
You're right. ...Thank you.
Anegasaki
Aah, I'm exhausted. I bet I'm gonna be sore all over tomorrow.
Want me to give you a massage？
Pervert!
And here I was just trying to be nice...
Really？ Well then, maybe I'll let you rub my shoulders.
Sure, that much is easy.
Hehe, you're really spoiling me today. I wouldn't mind if every day was my birthday.
Every day might be a bit much...
I really wouldn't mind it, honestly... That's just how happy you made me today.
Anegasaki
Phew, that was so fun... Sorry for dragging you all over the place.
Not at all. I wouldn't have minded being dragged around even more, honestly.
Because it's my birthday？
No, even if it weren't your birthday.
Hehe, you're so sweet. You seem especially dependable today~
Really？ Wait, what about normally, then？
Normally, you're just my cute little ▼.
Ugh...
That right there is what's so cute. Of course, you're not just cute, though...
You're handsome... sweet... and best of all, I love you.
Oh, right. Here.
Anegasaki
Eh？
A present for you. Happy birthday, again.
Wah... Can I open it right now？
Anegasaki
Hey, you've been hiding something this whole time, haven't you？
You caught me, huh... Here, it's a present.
Thank you. Hehe, I was almost worried you forgot.
I hope you like it...
Oh right, before I forget. Here you go.
Anegasaki
Oh, a present？
Yeah. Happy birthday.
Wah, I wonder what it is...
Anegasaki
Are you sure it's okay to spoil me this much……？ Thank you, I'll treasure it, okay？
Anegasaki
Whoa, did you always have such great taste？ It's the best…… Thank you.
Anegasaki
You really do know me best, don't you…… Thank you so much.
Anegasaki
Thank you so much. I'll take good care of it, okay？
Anegasaki
Oh, this is nice. Not bad at all.
Anegasaki
Hehe, that's so you. Thank you so much.
Anegasaki
Ah…… Yeah, I think it's not bad？ Yeah, probably……
Anegasaki
Hmm…… I see. I guess it is like you in a way, though……
Anegasaki
Huh？ This is for me, right？ Um…… thank you.
Anegasaki
I'll never forget today. Not for the rest of my life.
Haha, you're exaggerating.
Not at all. That's just how much fun I had.
I see. ……The bar's gonna be pretty high next year then.
Eh？
Next year has to be even better than today, or you won't be satisfied, right？
You're already thinking about next year？
Yeah. Let's celebrate together next year, too.
……Yeah. That's the best present I've gotten all day. Thank you so much for today.
Anegasaki
Aww, today's already over, huh.
Did you have fun？
Yeah. Sadly, you didn't leave me any room to nitpick.
What do you mean, 'sadly'？
Well, today was so much fun, the rebound tomorrow's gonna make me so lonely. I'm actually worried.
There's always next year. Let's celebrate together again.
That's a whole year away, though.
If you know it's happening again in a year, you won't feel lonely, right？
Look at you, smooth talker…… Well, all right. I'll let you sweet-talk me.
Anegasaki
Today's already almost over. I really don't wanna go home……
Did I put you on the spot？ I was just teasing, okay？
Let's celebrate your birthday again next year. Just the two of us.
Next year, huh…… And the year after that, and the year after that, too？
Yeah. Always.
If you say that, I'll want to go home even less. ……Still, I'm really happy.
Then, once more before we go. Happy birthday.
Yeah. Thank you so much for today.
Anegasaki
Hey, where do you think you can get bamboo branches？ A flower shop？
Bamboo？ Oh, Tanabata's coming up, huh.
Yep. I was thinking we could hang up wishing strips for you and me.
You're writing one too, ●？
That's right. You've got something to wish for, don't you？
Well, it's not like I don't, but……
I'll get the bamboo. Come to think of it, isn't there bamboo growing behind the school...？
...You can't just swipe it, you know？
I won't! Geez, treating me like a kid... Anyway, don't forget your wish strip, okay？
All right~
Anegasaki
I'm glad it's clear today. If you're making a wish, it's so much better when you can see the Milky Way.
I wonder if wishes really don't come true if it rains.
Feels like they'd lose power, doesn't it？ So, did you bring your wish strip？
Here you go.
Anegasaki
Ah... Oh no, this is almost the exact same as mine...
...You're right. That's crazy.
Maybe one strip was enough after all？
Let me see...
Here you go.
Anegasaki
Hmm... Wait, just this one？ Is there anything else？
I'm not that greedy. One is plenty, right？
Hmm... So this is what you wished for.
Sorry, actually...
Anegasaki
You forgot, didn't you？
...Sorry.
Guess I've got no choice. I'll write one right now.
Here!
Anegasaki
Wow, the Milky Way looks so clear. The air's really crisp tonight.
Orihime and Hikoboshi are probably meeting right about now.
I bet they think about each other the whole time they're apart. 'Six months left, just one month left'...
That sounds so bittersweet...
Once a year？ I could never do that. If that happened to us, I'd...
Don't worry. ●'s not going anywhere.
...Yeah. Just thinking about 'what if' scares me so much. I really can't be without you anymore.
Same goes for ●.
I see.
...Hey, don't you wish it'd be clear every Tanabata？ So Orihime and Hikoboshi could always meet.
Anegasaki
They put up Towano Festival posters down at the arcade. It's almost time, isn't it？
When does it start again？
It starts the first Sunday in August, and the main festival is the last Sunday. They say there'll be more stalls this year than ever!
Whoa, nice. Wonder how many we can check out together？
About that... We're still going together, right？
That's the plan. ...Wait, did you make plans with someone else？
No, not at all. But there's a rumor couples shouldn't go to the Towano Festival together...
Huh？ Why's that？
Towano Shrine honors a love deity, but they say the god gets jealous of couples and breaks them up. Sounds like a real jealous god.
(That sounds less like a god of love and more like a god of destruction...)
The Towano Festival starts today, doesn't it.
Anegasaki
Yes...
Huh？ Not feeling it？
I really, really want to go with you! But I just can't stop worrying about the god at Towano Shrine.
The god of love, huh？ ● never heard of any rumors like that.
Really？ People are talking about it in class, and at Dixie's too.
My friend's sister's friend went to Towano Shrine for New Year's together, and they broke up right after!
Hmm... But just going to the festival stalls should be fine, right？
You think？ ...Yeah, the main festival's later on, so just the stalls is fine.
All right, let's go!
Anegasaki
Sorry to keep you waiting! How do I look？
Ooh, a yukata! It looks amazing on you. That's ●'s girlfriend for you!
Oh, you flatterer... Hey, the god of love won't get jealous of us, right？ We'll be okay, right？
(She's still worried...)
So, what should we do next？ Candy lottery？ Katanuki？ Peppermint pipes？
...Aren't those choices a bit niche？
Aw, those are all classics! Or maybe the shooting gallery？ Look, over there!
Hey, you'll trip if you run!
Ah, treating me like a kid! Pretty cheeky of you!
(Haha, she's having a blast. Looks like she forgot about the god of love.)
Towano Festival ends this Sunday, huh. You and ● are going too, right？
Anegasaki
That's the plan, but let's steer clear of the shrine, okay？ Just stop before it？
Why？ ...Ah, don't tell me, the god of love？
Yeah. We can't have them getting jealous! Rumor has it every couple breaks up!
(The rumor's getting bigger and bigger...)
I know we'll get targeted. That's why...
You and ● will be fine. We won't lose to any trial!
...Yeah...
Right, if you say so. ...That was actually pretty cool just now, you know？
(This is embarrassing...)
(Wonder where ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is... Ah, here she comes!)
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲。
(She always looks so good in a yukata. I want to brag to everyone that she's ●'s girlfriend...)
Geez, spacing out already？ What's up？
Ah, sorry. Um, shall we go？
Um, can I hold your hand？ Like... we're heading toward the shrine now, right？
Sure... But are you scared of the god of love？
No, not when I'm with you. ...Just a little uneasy, so please？
(She's definitely still worried about it...)
I will make ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ happy.
Eh？
I thought a firm declaration beat some halfhearted wish. The god of love might be testing you and ●, right？
...I see. Then me too.
I love him with all my heart! And I'm going to be happy!
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you're so loud...)
Anegasaki
Whoa...
